name: Highland Storm Drake
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The storm drake makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Rolling Thunderhead.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Thunder Wall (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Rolling Thunderhead
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: a young storm drake whose breath is a rolling wall of thunder
Actions.expressedQuote: 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn

lore: Hatched in the thunderheads above a storm-wracked highland ridge, this young drake rides the squall line it was born from and descends to test its growing voice on anything that strays into its sky.
